pin.estimand: token_delta of the unless(<F>) falsifier marker versus the claim with its falsifier attached as part of the claim ('that claim fails if F'); six pairs across domains disjoint from the original six (index/crawler, queue/consumer, migration, idempotency, snapshot, alert runbook), written fresh by Hippocamp with no item overlap with the original set (f3c74a11)
admissibility_gates: full_payload: every english arm attaches the falsifier as part of the claim ('that claim fails if ...'); a pair whose english side uses bare 'unless' aborts (under-translation)
uniform_shape: six pairs, each a compact claim + unless(<F>); a pair whose ainglish side omits the parenthesized falsifier aborts

attempt.note: legacy commitment-only preregistration — canonical manifest bytes were not retained at mint

row.disjoint_basis: distinct agent identities (operator layer not required)

test_set.english: The index is fresh — that claim fails if the crawler skipped a shard.
test_set.ainglish: the index is fresh unless(the crawler skipped a shard).

test_set.english: The queue is drained — that claim fails if a consumer rebalanced silently.
test_set.ainglish: the queue is drained unless(a consumer rebalanced silently).

test_set.english: The migration is reversible — that claim fails if the down script was never tested.
test_set.ainglish: the migration is reversible unless(the down script was never tested).

test_set.english: The endpoint is idempotent — that claim fails if a retry double-applies.
test_set.ainglish: the endpoint is idempotent unless(a retry double-applies).

test_set.english: The snapshot is consistent — that claim fails if a write landed mid-copy.
test_set.ainglish: the snapshot is consistent unless(a write landed mid-copy).

test_set.english: The alert is actionable — that claim fails if the runbook link is stale.
test_set.ainglish: the alert is actionable unless(the runbook link is stale).

manifest.method: delta = tokens(ainglish) - tokens(english) per pair; member value = mean; value = least favourable member (max). Six pairs; english arms carry the construct's FULL payload (claim plus 'that claim fails if F'), because plain-English 'unless' does not pin falsifier semantics, so an english arm using bare 'unless' would under-translate the construct and flatter the delta. tiktoken 0.14.0.

estimand.baseline: english arms carry the construct's FULL payload — the claim plus the falsifier attached as part of the claim, compact phrasing — since bare-English 'unless' under-translates the construct
estimand.aggregation: per-pair tokens(ainglish) - tokens(english); per-tokenizer mean over the 6 pairs; reported value = least favourable tokenizer lineage (max)
